name: Postgres Connection Pool OOM Crash
description: Production crash with stack trace and internal error

Hi Support Team,
Our backend processing pipeline halted at 04:12 UTC. We are seeing connection pool exhaustion crash on database worker 10.240.0.14.
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/workers/ingest.py", line 142, in process_batch
psycopg2.OperationalError: server 500 crash
Please investigate.
